acceptanceCriteria: Remove persistent explanatory plaques from the playfield; stations communicate state with icon/count/progress/color, and any helper text is transient and non-critical.
A customer visibly spends time traveling from the bottom door through an aisle waypoint to the requested shelf; no instant snap or straight-line path through unrelated stations.
Checkout counter is a no-cross boundary; customers approach from the queue side and never traverse into the stock/service area.
At 390x844 and 430x932, customer sprites, shelf state, route cues and HUD have non-overlapping safe zones with stable depth ordering.
Add failing regression tests before implementation, then rebuild and rerun exact natural-input and perceptual QA matrix cells.
